# Cabo Sailing Ocean Adventures

> Private and shared yacht & sailboat charters in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico — snorkeling, sunset cruises, whale watching (Dec–Apr), scuba diving, and bachelorette parties. Operating from Cabo San Lucas Marina, Dock F.

Cabo Sailing operates a fleet of luxury yachts (42'/45'/51') and sailboats (38'/42') for private group charters, plus shared small-group sailing tours. Bilingual crew, all-inclusive pricing (open bar, food, gear), free cancellation up to 24 hours.

## Booking & Tours

- [Tours overview](https://cabosailing.com/tours/): All available activities — private and shared, sunset and snorkel
- [Special offers](https://cabosailing.com/special-offers/): Current discounts on yachts (35% off) and sailboats (40% off)
- [Contact](https://cabosailing.com/contact/): Phone, WhatsApp, email, and contact form

## Private Activities (charter the whole boat)

- [Private snorkeling](https://cabosailing.com/private-snorkeling/): 3-hour private charter — Pelican Rock or Chileno/Santa María Bay. Yachts up to 20 guests, sailboats up to 14
- [Private sunset cruise](https://cabosailing.com/private-sunset/): 3-hour golden-hour charter past Land's End and the Arch. Departures 4:00 PM (winter) / 4:15 PM (summer)
- [Whale watching](https://cabosailing.com/whale-watching/): Private humpback and gray whale charters, mid-December through mid-April, with naturalist guide
- [Scuba diving](https://cabosailing.com/scuba-diving/): PADI-led 4-hour tour for certified and non-certified divers in the Cabo San Lucas Reserve
- [Bachelorette party charter](https://cabosailing.com/bachelorette/): Private celebration cruises — yachts up to 20 guests, custom themes available

## Shared Activities (per-person pricing, max 14 guests)

- [Shared snorkeling tour](https://cabosailing.com/shared-snorkeling/): 9:00 AM daily, 3 hours, sail past the Arch and snorkel at Pelican Rock
- [Shared sunset cruise](https://cabosailing.com/shared-sunset/): 5:00 PM (winter) / 5:15 PM (summer), 2 hours, golden-hour sailing

## Shuttle Service

- [Shuttle service](https://cabosailing.com/shuttle-service/): Private airport and resort transfers in Cabo, Palmilla, and Puerto Los Cabos
